# Try Euclidean distance!
import numpy as np
def euclid(p,comp): return min((p[0]-a)**2+(p[1]-b)**2 for a,b in comp)
for nm in ('1','2'):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {nm} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {nm} output'])
    bgi = 9 if nm=='1' else 8
    h,w=I.shape; cs=comps(I,bgi); objs=[c for c in cs if len(c)>=2]
    print(f'=== demo{nm} Euclid ===')
    all_ok=True
    for p in zip(*np.where(I!=O)):
        i,j=p
        best=min(objs,key=lambda c:euclid(p,c))
        d=int(euclid(p,best)); col=int(I[best[0]])
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(x[0] for x in best),max(x[0] for x in best),min(x[1] for x in best),max(x[1] for x in best)
        inn=r0<i<r1 and c0<j<c1
        exp='OK' if col==int(O[p]) else 'FAIL'
        if exp=='FAIL': all_ok=False
        print(' ',p,'->',int(O[p]),'| euclid-nearest:',(d,col,len(best),'inn',inn),exp)
    print('all ok' if all_ok else 'FAILED')

import numpy as np

def comps(g,bg):
    g=np.array(g); seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(len(g)):
        for j in range(len(g[0])):
            if (i,j) in seen or g[i,j]==bg: continue
            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cs=[(i,j)]
            while q:
                x,y=q.popleft()
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    u,v=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=u<len(g) and 0<=v<len(g[0]) and (u,v) not in seen and int(g[u,v])==int(g[x,y]):
                        seen.add((u,v)); q.append((u,v)); cs.append((u,v))
            res.append(cs)
    return res

    objs=[c for c in comps(g,bg) if len(c)>=2]

from collections import deque,Counter as C
def comps_all(gin):
    g=[row[:] for row in gin]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=C(x for row in g for x in row); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    used=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bgc and (r,c) not in used:
                col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); used.add((r,c)); pts=[]
                while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft(); pts.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        u,v=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=u<h and 0<=v<w and (u,v) not in used and g[u][v]==col:
                            used.add((u,v)); q.append((u,v))
                rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
                R_,C_=min(rs),min(cs); H_=max(rs)-R_+1; W_=max(cs)-C_+1
                isrect = len(pts)==H_*W_
                out.append(dict(cells=pts,col=col,isrect=isrect,sz=len(pts)))
    return g,bgc,out
